notes:
- **Player**: A Description tab with clickable timestamps, YouTube's most replayed graph on the scrubber, section looping, and Ctrl+wheel zoom on a paused frame.
- **Shortcuts**: Every hotkey is listed in Settings > Keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+/), and you can rebind any of them.
- **Appearance**: Video mode now uses the black theme with your accent color, Compact density slims the title bar and side rail, and both can tuck away while a video plays.
- **Library**: Tag videos from the right-click menu and open a page for each tag. Finished downloads fly into their card.
- **Mini player**: Ghost mode keeps the mini player on top at low opacity and lets every click pass through (Ctrl+Alt+G).
- **Notifications**: Filter the island by uploads or downloads, and mute any kind you don't want.
- **Downloads**: Zen browser sign-in, size estimates that count the video stream, and a rate-limited caption no longer fails the whole video.
- **And more**: Up next sorting, end cards with creator avatars, auto captions in full phrases, faster switching between Library and Music, Settings inside Music, a private activity log that never leaves your PC, and fixes for lyrics, the island and the music player bar.
additions: Player: Description tab next to Comments, with clickable timestamps and chapters built from the description
Player: YouTube's most replayed graph above the scrubber

Player: Next up panel with a now-playing card, watch progress and a sort menu

App: switching between Library and Music keeps each mode's scroll and open page
